page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs, consisting of 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core, and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of memory per core. The instance is equipped with 1919 GB of local SSD storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. It operates on a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates that the ecs.i2.2xlarge generally exhibits weak to average performance. In CPU-focused evaluations, the instance achieved a PassMark CPU score of 6991.89 and a Geekbench single-core score of 960.0. Memory performance is mixed, with a weak read-only large block bandwidth of 39.23 GB/sec but an average large block write bandwidth of 35.45 GB/sec. Database operations on PassMark scored 2191.31, and Redis SET operations reached 6.06 million operations per second. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the server processed 442.93 tokens per second for prompt processing on a small 135M LLM model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i2.2xlarge offers a high local storage-to-vCPU density, bundling nearly 2 TB of SSD storage with 64 GB of RAM. This makes it a qualitatively viable option for workloads requiring significant local storage capacity without needing top-tier compute performance. Given the benchmark results, this instance is best suited for localized storage-heavy workloads, basic database hosting with moderate transaction volumes, and general-purpose applications that benefit from high local storage capacity.
